name: agent-delegation
description: Delegate meaningful missions between ACP-compatible agents while preserving worker agency and receipt-backed effect boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate missions across local agent CLIs.
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for handing meaningful missions between Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, zCode, OpenCode, and registered ACP agents while preserving normal capabilities and freedom of approach inside inherited authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-delegation to hand this mission to the most suitable registered agent, preserve its normal tools, let it choose the approach within my stated boundary and existing authorization, and return a receipt-backed result.
